statement: The function returns a result r and the following holds. If there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(nums) such that (i) nums[j] > nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and i != j, and (ii) 2 * nums[i] <= nums[j] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and i != j, then r = j. Otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 100; and the largest value in nums is unique, i.e. there exists exactly one index m with 0 <= m < len(nums) and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and i != m, nums[i] < nums[m].
